definitions.explanation: The legal or political right of a region, group, or institution to govern itself independently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自治権|じちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{自治権|じちけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められている→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: That region is granted broad autonomy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自治権|じちけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: University autonomy is guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{植民地|しょくみんち}→植民地：16073_shokuminchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって{自治権|じちけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{闘|たたか}って→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧きた。
examples.english: The people of the colony fought for years to obtain the right of self-governance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自治|じち}→自治：03985_jichi⟧ (self-governance) + {権|けん} (right). Used in political, legal, and academic contexts to discuss the right of communities, regions, or institutions to manage their own affairs without external control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自治権|じちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: recognize the right to self-governance
- {自治権|じちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: demand autonomy
- {自治権|じちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: obtain autonomy
- {自治権|じちけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧: expansion of autonomy
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{自治権|じちけん}: local autonomy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自治|じち}→自治：03985_jichi⟧: self-governance (the concept itself, without the "right" nuance)
- {自主権|じしゅけん}: sovereignty, independence (broader)
- ⟦{自律|じりつ}→自律：13955_jiritsu⟧: self-regulation, autonomy (often personal or organizational)
- ⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧: independence (complete separation, stronger than autonomy)
